title: Account
description: Public pages are open to everyone. To access squads, entries, and results, you must sign in.
sessionExpired: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
devNote: In development, the switcher in the bottom right lets you cycle through roles.

signIn.registerHint: A confirmation code will be sent to this address — the same way as signing in.
signIn.codeSentHint: If an account exists for {{email}}, a code is on its way. It's valid for ten minutes.
signIn.codeSentHintRegister: A confirmation code for {{email}} is on its way. It's valid for ten minutes — enter it to finish creating the account.
signIn.resent: A new code is on its way.

noPermissions: Nothing beyond public pages. Roles are assigned by the admin.
signedInNoRole: Signed in, but with no special role

roles.admin: Manage master data, series, matchdays, accounts and roles
roles.editor: Write posts and approve club contributions
roles.event_manager: Organize your own series and events: setup, clubs, people
roles.jury: Publish announcements and hear protests at your events

profile.title: My sailor profile
profile.description: Your name and birthdate as they appear on the site, and your own photo — visible to your club and, unless you're under 18, to everyone.
profile.noSailorRecord: No sailor record is linked to this account yet. An administrator or your club's leadership can create one and link it to your email address — then it will appear here.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: For now, this removes the account outright — a convenience while accounts are still mostly test data, not the permanent behavior.
deleteAccount.confirmPrompt: This cannot be undone. Delete the account permanently?

waiver.title: Liability waiver
waiver.description: One statement per series — or per event, when the event belongs to no series. It covers every matchday of that competition; a new wording asks for a new confirmation.
waiver.none: You are not entered in any competition yet, so there is nothing to sign.

status.guardian_signature_missing: Waiting for the guardian's signed form

waiver.needBirthDate: Enter your date of birth in the profile above first — it decides whether you confirm online or a parent has to sign.

adult.agree: I have read the statement above and agree to it for this competition.
adult.done: Thank you — your confirmation is recorded.

minor.explain: You are under 18 on the reference date, so a parent or legal guardian has to sign. Download the form, have it signed, and upload a photo or scan of it here (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB).
minor.guardianName: Name of the parent or guardian who signed
minor.done: The signed form is on file — you are cleared.
